title: After Rex: a record, Red Norvo rehearsal and the Spirits of Rhythm
summary: He thinks he recorded with Rex, rehearsed with Red Norvo and Mildred Bailey, and worked the Onyx Club with the Spirits of Rhythm, whose members he lists.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I mean, these things have been forgotten! [ETC.] After the Rex Stewart band at the Empire Ballroom, which was like a good break for you... Didn't you make a record with Rex at that time, too?
At that time, yes. I think it was with Stu
Yeah. When is it that you do this rehearsal with Red Norvo and Mildred Bailey? You did that at the Empire Ballroom.

Right. We did that, and I don't think it ever worked out. We were rehearsing for something together. And I remember going there... I don't know if it was before I left Rex or after I left Rex, when I worked there at the Onyx Club with him.
Is that where you met the Spirits of Rhythm, at that rehearsal?
No, I don't remember... No, I knew them all along, you know. Wilson Myers...
Well, anyway, you went in the Onyx Club with the Spirits of Rhythm.
Let's just rattle the names off there. That's...
Wilbur Daniels, Douglas Daniels, Teddy Bunn, Leo... Virgil Scoggins on the (?); he used to play on the bag...
